name: Crystal the Witch
source:
Join Crystal, and her cat Lily, as they prepare to brew a special potion for an upcoming Halloween event! Although a young witch in training, Crystal believes herself far superior to the average witch. However, her quick temper and stubborn nature may bring her plans to a crushing halt.

[From [url=https://devikomi.itch.io/crystal-the-witch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入克莉丝朵与她的猫咪莉莉，一起为即将到来的万圣节活动调制特别的魔药吧！虽然还只是年轻的见习女巫，克莉丝朵却自认远胜一般女巫。然而，她急躁的脾气与固执的性格，可能会让计划彻底泡汤。

[摘自[url=https://devikomi.itch.io/crystal-the-witch]Itch.io[/url]]
